name: smwmusic-duke-nukem-3d-ready-your-guns-grabbag-remix
title: Duke Nukem 3D - Ready Your Guns!! ~ Grabbag (Remix)
description:
𝗡𝗼𝗯𝗼𝗱𝘆 𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗹𝘀 𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗰𝗵𝗶𝗰𝗸𝘀... 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗹𝗶𝘃𝗲𝘀!

Did an arrangement of Grabbag, the godly and hype-as-hell masterpiece of a title / main theme in a shooter and one of my favorite theme songs from the genre. Got into Duke Nukem very recently while I was on a rampage to find boomer shooters to play. I may be more of a DOOM guy, but Duke Nukem is f***ing awesome!!!

Important:
♠ "Bonus End," P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. Enables the funny line (Listening-Only)
2. Disables the funny line (SMW-Compatible, turned on default)
